performance.verdict: CPL spike is real; but 0 pipeline wins on 101 opps exposes an intake failure, not just ad fatigue.

findings.text: CPL surged 82.85% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 8–10) produced only 6 leads on $84.90 spend vs 11 leads on $75.33 in the prior 3 days — confirmed efficiency collapse.
OVERDUE: Dashboard live and August scoreboard trusted (due 2026-08-31) — 0 pipeline wins on 101 created opportunities; renewal decision is blind without this.
OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved — 75 GBP calls in 28 days are unattributed to GHL pipeline.
GBP actions fell 51.72% week-over-week; last 4 logged days show 0 actions (Sep 7–10), suggesting either a dark period or a data-feed gap — organic floor is eroding alongside paid.
101 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments logged in GHL — leads are arriving but no intake conversion is recorded; this is a pipeline intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Introduce at least 1 new creative variant into BWS Retargeting; hold spend flat while CPL is 82.85% above prior week.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL jumped 82.85% week-over-week on flat spend (+0.88%), and the last 3 days yielded only 6 leads vs 11 in the prior 3-day window — a textbook fatigue pattern on the BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting campaign ($374.99 of 28-day spend). Launch at least one new creative variant into this campaign without increasing daily budget ($26.01/day current pace) until CPL returns below the 28-day baseline of $7.46. Success check: CPL at or below $7.46 over any 3-day window by 2026-09-17.

suggestions.text: Close the GHL intake leak: audit why 101 created opportunities show 0 won and 0 appointments logged.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 101 opportunities created with $0 won value and 0 appointments logged — leads are entering but no intake conversion is recorded anywhere in the funnel. Additionally, 75 GBP calls in the 28-day window are not attributed to any pipeline stage (phone-match gap overdue since 2026-08-07). Audit the opportunity stage workflow with Ahmed/Ali Shaheer and confirm Lily's intake process against the biweekly sync. Success check: at least 10 opportunities in a post-contact stage and appointment count > 0 in GHL by 2026-09-17.

suggestions.text: Escalate the 3 overdue SOW milestones to Sohib/Nacer; dashboard and scoreboard are the renewal gate.
suggestions.monday_update: Three milestones are past due: phone-match attribution (2026-08-07), sync/contact cleanup (2026-08-14), and the dashboard + August scoreboard (2026-08-31). The client's renewal decision is explicitly tied to seeing legitimate leads flow to scheduled and shown patients — that scoreboard does not exist yet. Escalate to Sohib (Account) and Nacer (Ops) with a hard delivery date. Success check: dashboard live and scoreboard reviewed with client by 2026-09-17.
